rubric: Formal layout of the user's country and language: sender, receiver, date, subject with the reference, greeting, closing, attachments.
Facts, the single demand with a deadline, and the consequence each in their own paragraph; written confirmation requested.
Every fact the user did not give is a bracketed placeholder; no invented law, paragraph, fee or right.
After the letter: 2 to 4 practical lines (proof of delivery, keep a copy, what to do after the deadline).
150 to 300 words, plain, no emotion or threats beyond what the user can really do.
